sql: select t.occurred_at, t.from_state, t.to_state, t.actor, t.approved_by, v.version, ep.epoch_number, left(coalesce(t.reason,''),300) as reason from experiment_state_transitions t join experiments e on e.id = t.experiment_id left join experiment_versions v on v.id = t.version_id left join experiment_epochs ep on ep.id = t.epoch_id where e.key = 'mmsell-price-ceiling' order by t.occurred_at
